wrote:
After speaking with Bridget, I had a chat with my usual contact on Meta's security team to make sure
tomorrow's call is as productive as possible. A few tidbits to guide your thinking -
Most importantly, yesterday FB made two significant changes to policy that have global reach and impact,
but are relevant to Slovakia. Note that at least the first change is public, but FB isn't trying to promote them
given that they're worried about further punitive action from the Kremlin (and thus I couldn't find any news
stories about them).
1. FB "won't allow governments that have instituted sustained blocks of social media to use their official
departments, agencies, and embassies to deny the use of force or violent events in the context of ar
attack against the territorial integrity of another state in violation of Article 2(4) of the UN charter." lI
other words this content is subject to take-down.
1. FB is now downranking content exempt from #1 above generated by Russian embassies.
